name: Data#3 Limited
summary: Data#3 Limited provides information technology services and solutions in Australia. The company operates through three segments: Software Solutions, Infrastructure Solutions, and Services. It offers hybrid cloud solutions, such as public cloud Azure and modern data centre; collaboration, Microsoft 365 Copilot, end user compute, and systems management solutions; and data security and privacy, cloud security, identity and access management, infrastructure endpoint security, security monitoring and analytics.
